Grated the traditional way

What sets PTF apart is a traditional preparation process and the natural retention of fibre and coconut milk. The result is fresher, more authentic and closer to homemade.

Traditional grating

Our coconut is grated using a traditional method that keeps its natural freshness, texture and authentic taste.

Fibre and milk retained

Unlike many grated coconut products in the market, ours keeps the coconut’s natural fibre and milk, preserving a rich texture and natural flavour.

Hygienic and consistent

Fresh daily grating, clean handling and consistent quality control, so every pack arrives fresh, clean and ready to use.

Perfect for every kitchen

Our fresh grated coconut works across a wide range of food preparations.

Chutneys
Fresh coconut chutney, dips and traditional recipes.
Curries
Adds authentic coconut flavour to Indian and coastal curries.
Sweets and desserts
Modak, barfi, ladoos, payasam and festive sweets.
Bakery products
Cakes, cookies, fillings, toppings and coconut-based desserts.
South Indian dishes
Dosa chutney, idli chutney, upma, kootu and more.
Catering and bulk cooking
Saves time and effort in large-scale food preparation.
Solkadi
A cooling kokum-coconut drink.

About us

We provide fresh, hygienically grated coconut made from carefully selected coconuts and packed to retain natural freshness, taste and quality.

Our product is designed for everyday cooking as well as commercial food preparation, making it a reliable choice for homes, restaurants, caterers, sweet makers, bakeries and food businesses.

With a focus on freshness, hygiene and consistent supply, we aim to make coconut preparation easier, faster and more convenient without compromising on purity.
